ValidationRule.description: When a contract is ended further details must be given. --> To be done at Market Flow Level for France
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Profile.Name<>'System Administrator' && $Profile.Name <>'Global Delegated Admin' && $Profile.Name <>'Global Controlling User' && $Profile.Name <> 'Integration User' && ISPICKVAL( Status__c, 'Ended') && (ISBLANK(TEXT(Global_Contract_Ended_Reason__c)) || ISBLANK (Further_Details__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The contract ended reason field must be selected and further details added when the contract status is changed to ended.
